notices.body_en: To be clear: this game package is a fan-made modified version. It is not an official DroneFlames release, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original developer. The mods on this website are community creations as well. If you enjoy the game, please support the original developer through official channels.
notices.body_zh: 先说清一件事：这个游戏安装包是玩家自制的修改版，不是 DroneFlames 的官方版本，与原版作者和官方没有任何隶属或授权关系。官网上的 mod 同样是玩家社区作品。喜欢这款游戏的话，请到官方渠道支持原作者。
notices.title_en: Please note: this is not an official version
notices.title_zh: 关于版本：这不是官方版本

notices.body_en: Two online tools are now in the portal's top navigation — no installs needed, they run right in your browser for 0.41 mods. Image Mod Maker: upload images or generate them with AI to reskin units and clone buildings and units; it can also write prompts and scripts with AI, and repair script errors you paste in or screenshot. Map Maker: turn an uploaded image, a seed-generated terrain, or an AI-generated heightmap into a map pack with countries and capitals. AI features are free with a GitHub sign-in, with a daily free quota. Packs are built to the official editor's export format and pass the official checker; before importing on your device, please try a small pack first.
notices.body_zh: 门户顶部导航新增两个在线工具，不用装软件，浏览器里就能做 0.41 的 mod：「图片做 mod」可以上传图片或用 AI 生成图片，做单位换皮、建筑克隆和单位克隆，还能让 AI 帮忙写提示词、写脚本，脚本导入报错也可以贴出来让 AI 修；「地图做 mod」可以上传图片、按种子生成地形或用 AI 生成高度图，配好国家和首都就能打包成地图包。AI 功能用 GitHub 账号登录后免费使用，每天有免费额度。工具产出的包按官方编辑器的导出格式制作、通过了官方检查脚本；往真机里导入前，建议先拿一个小包试一下。
notices.title_en: Mod-making tools are live: Image Mod Maker & Map Maker
notices.title_zh: 做 mod 工具上线：图片做 mod、地图做 mod
